title: University of Miami Health System - SCCC
description:
University of Miami Health System - SCCC is the UM Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center's Kendall location, a hospital-based facility of University of Miami Hospital & Clinics. BDI Construction renovated an office and patient treatment rooms within the facility.

The scope covered curtained infusion bays with reclining treatment chairs, a central nurses' station and supply area, and an updated reception and waiting room.
